title: Penalty not awarded: challenge by Canvot on Branthwaite
summary: Penalty not awarded: Challenge by Canvot on Branthwaite. Panel: The on-field offside call against Branthwaite was supported as the offside offence occurred before the possible penalty. The panel felt that had an offside offence not taken place a penalty should have been awarded for the challenge by Canvot.
